stage: Post-run interpretation of the predeclared offline spectrum audit
scope: Standalone actual-header symbols and 3x3 algebra only. No production edits, MSBuild substitution, project solver, formal-case or GPU execution.

results.max_all_initial_state_case: J1.01,m2,k1e-4,dt2^-23; diagnostic nonnormal amplification, not monotone energy conservation

source_integrator.actual_lines: JSphCpuSingle.cpp ComputeStep_Sym: predictor Interaction_Forces -> ComputeSymplecticPre -> RunCellDivide -> corrector Interaction_Forces -> ComputeSymplecticCorr. JSphCpu.cpp pressure helpers4289/4306 and velocity/stress updates4355/4504 implement old+dt/2*rate then old+dt*midpoint-rate.
source_integrator.conclusion: Only the frozen elastic no-auxiliary [v,Sxx,p] exact-arithmetic subsystem has R=I+dt*A+dt^2*A^2/2. Actual float velocity/pressure/rate writes, moving positions, nonlinear J, plasticity, boundaries and sorting are outside that equality.
source_integrator.position_not_same_map: Actual corrector uses dt/2*(v_old+v_new). Do not apply the frozen three-variable polynomial to full particle positions or J.

k0_not_asymptotically_stable.identity: For acoustic lambda=i*omega, |R|^2=1+(omega*dt)^4/4>1. The third static mode has lambda0=0 and R0=1. Use log1p to retain tiny positive acoustic growth even if direct eigenvalues round to1.
k0_not_asymptotically_stable.interpretation: Halving dt reduces per-step log amplification approximately16-fold and fixed-time accumulated log amplification approximately8-fold. Tiny finite-window growth is not strict infinite-time stability. No low-k search was performed.

preselected_m4_candidate.native_geometry: Retain actual128 nodes,16x8 periodic,dp2^-7,Lx.125,Lz.0625 and original material. Do not impose uniform J1.01 deformation inside the fixed box.
preselected_m4_candidate.initial_state: Use J1,p0,effective stress0 and the same weak vx amplitude2^-9, but sin(8*pi*x/Lx). No damping,HigherHG,SPR,wall,load or shifting change.
preselected_m4_candidate.sampling_proposal: 65 exact paired times at coarse dt; half every2steps, plus all actual predictor/corrector stage audits
preselected_m4_candidate.keep_original_physical_gates: Original5Pa pressureRMS/.005mm displacement independent half gate,128native IDs/no exclusion,ledger/saturation/finite elastic bounds,actual current-n cu/CFL and diffusion-step audits,energy<=1.1,all actual postforce-rate/sentinel/periodic-owner assembly checks. No physical gate is replaced by these frozen spectra.
preselected_m4_candidate.high_frequency_not_continuum_accuracy: m4 has4 particles per wavelength; J1 k0 frozen acoustic frequency31791.685/s versus continuum cu*k=102943.708/s. This intentionally underresolved mode probes implementation/time policy, not continuum spatial accuracy or full-spectrum completeness.

minimum_private_time_policy_followup.default_OFF: Leave existing u-pw path and all old step choices unchanged.
minimum_private_time_policy_followup.private_dynamic_ON: At each native force state derive n,V,rho from J; use cu=sqrt((K+4G/3+Kw/n)/rho) rather than existing drained Cs0 and retain current-porosity diffusion limit D=(Kw/n)*k/gamma. Preserve the existing acceleration/viscosity limits. Reject invalid ledger states rather than silently clamp them.
minimum_private_time_policy_followup.limits: Those scalar CFL/diffusion bounds are necessary controls, not a proof for the full acceleration-coupled operator. A semidiscrete growing root cannot be repaired by smaller dt. A strict absolute-stability promise at k0 is impossible for this midpoint polynomial; any initial private policy must disclose bounded-window accuracy/energy scope and await actual m4 validation.
minimum_private_time_policy_followup.not_a_domain_proof: The fixed-lattice J1.01 coefficient experiment is not globally compatible uniform deformation. Continuous Routh/Jcrit work is separately recorded; neither it nor this14-symbol set proves arbitrary deforming/nonuniform/3D/boundary stability.
